headline: FY'27 budget transfer request, donation to Waltham High School's CTE Department, and student enrollment topics.
summary: This meeting will review a FY'27 budget transfer request, bills on warrant, and consent agenda items such as retirements, resignations, and a donation to Waltham High School's CTE Department. It will also continue discussions on anti-racism initiatives, the dual language school model, the high school schedule, and enrollment data in the Waltham Public Schools.
